status: Engineering calibration, not an exact measured tire reproduction

coldSnowResponse.basis: Conservative engineering defaults informed by snow shearing literature. Not digitized or fitted manufacturer measurements. Peak force is unchanged. Wetness and ice blend back toward the existing response.

measuredComparison.limits: Different vehicle, tires, and snow. Acceleration time is not a friction coefficient; absolute times cannot be transferred to RTG-001. Defender is a strong all-season example, not representative of every factory tire. Use category comparisons as constraints, not a universal ratio.

knownLimitations: No complete manual engine-stall simulation was added.
No snow sinkage or density-specific physical shear simulation was added.
Controlled slopes do not validate every imported mountain corner.

Aids-off Stock at 55% throttle on level snow drifted 1.17 m over the stop/restart run, versus 0.0015 m with an explicitly restored old curve. Holding first gear did not remove it (1.44 m). At 25% throttle drift was 0.00057 m. Substantial wheelspin accompanies the higher-throttle response; this is not proof that its lateral behavior matches a real vehicle. No corrective steering was applied.

hillMatrix.assists: ABS and TC both enabled, then both disabled
passed: Snow > Offroad > Stock restart speed for every grade and assist combination
